response.overview: Go-Yun, the main character, wants to quit the job she started because she liked it, but at some point, it becomes difficult when she treats it as work only. At that time, his younger brother Jae-yun said he wanted to do the same thing as his older sister. The main character tries his best to stop and interfere with his younger brother, fearing that he will become like him. However, fighting together with his younger brother gave him an opportunity to rediscover why he liked this job. Talking directly with the characters in his work, he finds the reason why he wanted to do this.
response.title: I hate but like it
